text.aria-label: Title text 'Coverage from day 4 of a load-shift to its end, against false triggers Dot: mean over events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed lines: the 0.90 target and 1 false trigger per Primary-year. Rows 24 to 120 h ahead, both groups. Upper left is better.'
text.tspan: Coverage from day 4 of a load-shift to its end, against false triggers
Dot: mean over events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events.
Dashed lines: the 0.90 target and 1 false trigger per Primary-year. Rows 24 to 120 h ahead, both groups. Upper left is better.
